common: Use case: stylized-concept. Lumia Chronicles original warm academic classical fantasy game asset. Fine hand drawn ink outlines, soft watercolor and colored pencil matte texture, cream parchment, sage green, restrained coral and antique brass, quiet turquoise rune light. Cohesive readable game art, no logos, no words, no letters, no UI text, no watermark, no scenery unless specifically a tile/backdrop, no border unless requested. No photorealism, plastic 3D, neon, excessive ornate gold. One asset only. Full object visible, clean contour, appropriate breathing room. Transparent background when requested, fully opaque object interiors except intentional glass/glow.

assets.name: 조사_식물_시듦
assets.delta: Single investigation plant in simple shallow cream ceramic planter with sage band. Three long drooping leaves, curled dull sage leaf tips, one lowered cream flower bud. Clearly wilted but not dead or rotten. 2.5D view looking down35 degrees, bottom center anchor, whole planter. This design will have a restored state.

assets.name: 조사_식물_회복
assets.delta: Edit the reference wilted plant into recovered state. Preserve EXACT planter, camera, scale, ground anchor, stem count, canvas and style. Raise the same three leaves to healthy posture and open the same cream flower bud. Fresh sage-green, subtle turquoise light near stem only. No added leaves, pots, background, or objects.

assets.name: 달빛_약초
assets.delta: Single collectible moonlight herb, three silvery sage pointed leaves and one tiny pale blue moon-shaped blossom, subtle pearly turquoise veins. Small soil root base, no pot, 2.5D top-front35-degree view, strong simple silhouette readable as inventory icon, transparent, full object.

assets.name: 사건_룬_비활성
assets.delta: Edit reference existing shadow rune for small greenhouse adventure object. Preserve oval cream stone shape and central leaf rune identity. Remove surrounding smoke, reduce micro-ornament for small gameplay readability, matte dark burgundy inactive channels, no emitted light. Camera top-front35 degrees, full stone isolated transparent with generous margin.

assets.name: 사건_룬_활성
assets.delta: Edit reference inactive encounter rune to activated state. Preserve EXACT stone silhouette, cracks, camera, position, ornament and leaf glyph. Change only dark channels to soft turquoise illuminated channels and gentle warm restored surface. No new glyphs, no new objects, transparent background.
